items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

4 - 7 years of related experience in provider relations, health plan network development, physician recruitment, medical group/IPA operations, employee benefits brokerage, or a related healthcare business development role.

Primarily field-based, with regular travel throughout Riverside and San Bernardino counties to physician offices, employer sites, and community events, plus time on campus. Occasional evening or weekend events, particularly during open enrollment.

Conducts frequent on-site visits and collaborates with key staff on policy and process development to maximize referrals. -Conducts on-site visits to independent physician practices, medical groups, and IPAs to recruit them into the UCR Health managed care network and CIN, and to support practices already in the network. - Conducts relationship-building visits to insurance brokers, employer benefit managers, HR directors, local governments, school districts, and community groups as assigned. - Develops candidate providers for network based on need, geography, and opportunity. - Creates feedback loops between practices and UCR Health operations to reduce leakage and improve onboarding. (25% time)

Maintains accurate record of contacts, meetings and educational activities. Analyzes referral patterns for trends identifying areas for improvement. - Maintains a daily CRM capturing activity - Monitors provider landscape and develops relationships with key leaders among providers (15% time)

Identifies key contacts within assigned organizations and establishes effective working relationships with administration and / or clinical staff. - Builds and manages a pipeline of target practices in priority geographies and specialties, cultivating relationships with physician owners, practice administrators, and office managers. - Guides recruited physicians through the contracting process in coordination with UCR Health managed care contracting, and maintains contact after onboarding to support participation and retention. (15% time)

Provides onsite follow-up and education for referrals. Engages in follow-up subsequent to program participation. - Provides continuity oversight linking contracting, credentialing, onboarding, and participation with network providers - Closes communication loops with community partners to maintain visibility and trust. (10% time)

Develops and implement marketing strategies to enhance referrals. Identifies barriers to referral practices at assigned hospitals / organizations. - Partners with Marketing on provider-facing materials, such as co-branding with providers, network participation overviews for prospective practices. - Identifies barriers and works with UCR Health leadership to remove them. (10% time)

Develops and presents evidence-based education plans to administrators and / or clinical providers. - Develops and gives presentations for prospective practices, broker offices, employer benefit fairs, union meetings, civic organizations, and community health coalitions explaining UCR Health services, network participation, PCP selection, specialty strengths, and access points. - Prepares data-driven presentations tailored to each audience. (10% time)

Applies best practices to assigned hospitals / organizations. Collaborates on projects and activities. -Applies community engagement best practices to foster pipeline relationships with employer groups, schools, public agencies, and regional organizations to increase UCRH visibility. - Collaborates with employers on wellness workshops, onsite screenings, flu shot clinics, and partner-branded service days to drive recognition and referrals. (5% time)

Stays current on outreach / program development best practices and relevant rules and regulations. -Keeps up to date with health plan policy changes, employer benefits trends, and broker commission structures to better position UCRH. - Monitors ACA, Medicare Advantage, Medi-Cal managed care, and CalPERS rules affecting employer groups and referral pathways. (5% time)

Participates in relevant professional organizations and represents programs at professional conferences. - Represents UCR Health at broker meetings, HR networking groups, and employer consortiums. - Builds the UCRH brand at community and civic events (chambers of commerce, rotary clubs, trade associations, etc.). - Serves as a liaison between UCRH and regional employer coalitions to promote UCRH as a preferred regional health partner. (5% time)
